status: recovered from the shipped product contract and independent verification after the original brief file was absent

opportunity.audience: People who need to send sensitive tax, medical, legal, identity, or credential files to a recipient who may not be technically confident.
opportunity.job_to_be_done: Create a password-protected handoff locally, explain the two-channel delivery procedure clearly, and remember only whether the recipient opened it.
opportunity.problem: Generic file sharing leaves senders to improvise encryption, password separation, recipient instructions, and follow-up. That creates avoidable mistakes and support burden.

free: Create an AES-256 encrypted ZIP entirely in the browser
Generate, download, and print a plain-language recipient sheet
Record sent and opened acknowledgements in a local IndexedDB log
Export and strictly validated import of the local log

paid.name: Pro
paid.feature: Add a short personal note to the recipient sheet
paid.provider: Sociobot billing API with Dodo as merchant of record

privacy.default: Files, ZIP passwords, recipient sheets, and ZIPs stay on the device.
privacy.network: Core use makes no off-origin request. License verification is user-triggered and goes through a rate-limited same-origin gateway to the Sociobot API.

acceptance: The recipient can decrypt every selected file with the supplied password and receives compatible-extractor guidance.
Wrong passwords fail and duplicate source file names do not abort creation.
A sender can update sent/opened state after reload or returning later.
Storage failure never withholds an already-created ZIP or sheet.
Offline installed use, legal routes, and service-worker updates remain recoverable.
Desktop, keyboard, screen-reader semantics, and 390px mobile meet the factory accessibility baseline.
